name: Zootique
description: Our largest main boutique with the widest variety of souvenirs, toys, plush, apparel, books, jewelry, and more! Something for everyone, from every region of the Zoo.

name: Eurasia Wilds Outpost
description: Located by our endangered Amur Tiger exhibit, this indoor shop offers a variety of tiger themed souvenirs and gifts, as well as your other favourite Eurasian species!

name: Savanna Shop
description: An indoor gift shop located by the Africa Zoomobile station. Souvenirs, toys, plush, apparel, and exclusive African gifts to remember some of your favourite species found in the African Savanna.

name: Twiga Market
description: A breezy outdoor market located directly in front of our Giraffe exhibit. Specializing in Giraffe, Hippo, and Gorilla themed souvenirs and gifts.
